title: Decanter Centrifuge

introduction.definition: A decanter centrifuge separates solids from liquid continuously. A horizontal solid bowl spins at high speed so the solids settle against its wall. A scroll conveyor inside turns slightly slower or faster than the bowl (differential speed) and pushes the settled solids up the conical beach to the solids outlet; clarified liquid overflows the weirs at the other end.
key_points: Differential speed controls cake dryness and residence time
Pool depth set by weir plates

working_principle.characteristic_curve: Cake dryness vs centrate clarity trade-off: lower differential speed → drier cake but more solids loss.

pressure.title: High g-force settles solids against the bowl
pressure.description: Rotating at a few thousand rpm, the bowl creates ~ 2 000–4 000 g. Solids settle on the bowl wall; the scroll, turning a few rpm slower or faster (differential speed), pushes them up the conical beach out of the liquid and out of the bowl. Clarified liquid overflows the adjustable weir plates at the other end.

video_tutorials.title: Decanter Centrifuge — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Decanter Centrifuge.
A decanter centrifuge separates solids from liquid continuously.
A horizontal solid bowl spins at high speed so the solids settle against its wall.

A scroll conveyor inside turns slightly slower or faster than the bowl (differential speed) and pushes the settled solids up the conical beach to the solids outlet; clarified liquid overflows the weirs at the other end.
Typical applications include sludge dewatering (wastewater); drilling-mud and oil-sludge treatment; olive oil and food processing; chemical and mineral slurries.

The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Casing with Solids Chute (cone end) & Centrate Chute (cylinder end), Cylindro-Conical Bowl (rotates ≈ 2 000–4 000 rpm), Bowl Head with Adjustable Weir Plates (turns with the bowl), Scroll Conveyor (turns slightly slower than the bowl — differential speed).
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Decanter Centrifuge — Operation

script.narration: How the Decanter Centrifuge works.
Feed enters through the central pipe into the bowl.
Solids settle on the bowl wall under high g.
The scroll conveys solids up the beach.
The gearbox sets the differential speed.
Clear liquid overflows the weirs; cake drops out at the cone end.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.
Rotating at a few thousand rpm, the bowl creates ~ 2 000–4 000 g.

video_tutorials.title: Decanter Centrifuge — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Decanter Centrifuge.
Monitor vibration, torque, differential speed.
Inspect scroll flight wear.
Re-hard-face scroll; bearing and gearbox overhaul.
Watch for scroll wear: wet cake, falling capacity. Common cause: abrasive solids.
Watch for overtorque: trip. Common cause: high solids load.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
